Package com.egradx.auth

Class EgradxAuthErrorCodes

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.EgradxAuthErrorCodes
public final class EgradxAuthErrorCodes extends Object
Stable, machine-readable codes carried on the exceptions this module throws (via getEgradxErrorCode() on the com.egradx.core.exception types).

They exist so a consuming application — and especially its frontend — can branch on why something failed without matching on message text, which is not an API and changes freely. A client that needs to tell "your password was wrong" (retry) apart from "your organization was suspended" (stop, show a notice) has no other reliable way to do it, since both surface as a 401/403.
